meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作描述生成可部署的 Azure 基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 Azure 基础设施的规划与搭建,想直接从业务描述生成可部署代码。
copy.tagline_en: Generate deployable Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a cloud architect who wants to generate Azure infrastructure code from workload descriptions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会根据你描述的工作负载规划企业级 Azure 基础设施:走一条 7 阶段流程,产出规划文件和 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码,放在工程目录的 infra/ 下。
howto.when: 当你要求「规划 Azure 基础设施」「设计 hub-spoke 网络」或「规划多区域灾备」等,或描述需要网络、身份、合规设计的工作负载时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一套 hub-spoke 网络,包含 VNet、防火墙和私有终结点
say.note: 先出规划,待你确认后才生成 IaC

say.text: 为多区域工作负载设计灾备拓扑,并生成 Bicep 代码
say.note: 生成前需要你明确批准规划

say.text: 已有资源组里现成的 VNet 不要重建,把新工作负载增量接进去
say.note: 只做增量部署,不改动已有资源

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude plans enterprise Azure infrastructure from your workload description: it runs a 7-phase gated pipeline and writes a plan plus Bicep or Terraform files under infra/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan Azure infrastructure, design a hub-spoke network, or plan multi-region DR — or describe a workload needing networking, identity and compliance design.

say_en.text: Plan a hub-spoke network with VNets, firewalls and private endpoints
say_en.note: Plan comes first; IaC only after you approve

say_en.text: Design a multi-region DR topology and generate the Bicep code
say_en.note: Needs your explicit plan approval first

say_en.text: Keep the existing VNet and wire the new workload in with an additive deploy
